entries.zh: 卒：完结、终了；猝然即尽（顷刻之间就完了）
entries.en: finished, ended; done with suddenly, in a moment

entries.zh: 丧：丧失、失去；丧亡、遭丧（败亡无余）
entries.en: lost, ruined; bereaved, mourning; undone and destroyed

entries.zh: 残：将尽、将残；残余未尽（如时日将残、将毕）
entries.en: nearly spent, running out; leftover, what remains of something (or of time) almost gone

entries.zh: 残灯：残灯（灯油将尽、灯将熄灭）；喻节期将残（二月节将过）
entries.en: guttering lamp, its oil nearly spent and about to go out; metaphorically, a feast season (the February feast) winding down

entries.zh: 做成：做成、制成（完完全全做好）
任满：任期届满（如法官、教长任满卸任）
entries.en: term of office completed (as of a judge or prelate)
entries.notes: 西栏 off.º 为缩写（oficio），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 定叠了：定叠了、办妥定当了结（事情妥定完结）
entries.en: all settled and concluded; properly finished, well done

entries.zh: 事定了：事情已定、就此了结
entries.en: the matter is settled and done with

entries.zh: 断根：断根、连根拔除（把讼事等根除了断）
entries.en: cut at the root, eradicate; to end (a lawsuit) once and for all

entries.zh: 结果：结果、结出果实；善始善终（有好收场）
entries.en: to bear fruit; to end well, carry a thing through to a good conclusion

entries.zh: 竭尽：竭尽、用尽到头（直至终结）
entries.en: to exhaust, use up utterly; carry to the very end

entries.zh: 衰微：衰微、衰减殆尽（再无剩余）
entries.en: dwindled away, worn down to nothing with nothing left over

entries.zh: 随手成：随手即成、一挥而就（顷刻办妥）
entries.en: accomplished at a stroke, done on the spot and perfectly
entries.notes: 西栏 perfecta m.te 为 mente 缩写（perfectamente），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 缴结：缴结、缴清了结（钱粮公事缴完结清）
entries.en: paid off and concluded; accounts or a case settled and closed
the matter accomplished, a thing brought to completion

entries.zh: 事明白：事情明白、事已分明（就此了结）
entries.en: the matter clear and understood, hence concluded

entries.zh: 定夺：定夺、裁定定案（事情定下）
易过：容易过去、轻易度过（难关时日易过）
entries.en: passes easily; something gotten over without difficulty

entries.zh: 安静、静下；使啼哭者安静〔字义存疑〕
entries.en: to hush, quiet one who cries; be still
entries.notes: 字栏作“晴”（天晴义）与西栏“哄止啼哭者”义不合，疑原字为形近之“静”，语义无法定夺故降为低置信。
